description: Four equal notes from the first-sound steps. At 90 BPM, for four bars, the course project at this stage plays C3 on steps 1 to 4 of a four-step cycle, each at velocity 80 and half a step long, so six identical notes sound every second. Listen for an even pulse of identical notes with no accent, rest or change of pitch.
